title.en: Maintenance of the Special Fund of the Special Committee on Naturalization Under Letter of Instructions No. 270 and the Non-Reversion of Its Current Funds to the General Surplus Fund At the End of the Fiscal Year

text.en:
The provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, all monies collected from the
sales of forms and the receipt of docket and other naturalization fees shall not be reverted to the General
Surplus Funds at the end of the fiscal year 1975 but shall remain as a special account available for continuing
outlay by the President for the operation of the Special Committee on Naturalization and for such other
purposes as may be provided by decree or regulations.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of June, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
